name: AWS Textract
label: Amazon Textract — document text and IDP
description: Official Amazon Textract JSON 1.1 API. POST https://textract.{region}.amazonaws.com/ signed with AWS SigV4 (service textract). Content-Type application/x-amz-json-1.1 and X-Amz-Target Textract.{Action} are set per operation. operation: detect_text (DetectDocumentText), analyze_document, analyze_expense, analyze_id. Prefer Document / DocumentPages as official Bytes or S3Object. ID and PII in documents — minimize retention. Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation Textract JSON. Prefer Document / DocumentPages as official {Bytes} or {S3Object} objects. JPEG, PNG, PDF, or TIFF. Never put AWS keys here. Example: {"Document":{"S3Object":{"Bucket":"docs","Name":"invoice.pdf"}},"FeatureTypes":["FORMS","TABLES"]}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: detect_text | analyze_document | analyze_expense | analyze_id.

schema.label: Document
schema.description: Official Document for detect_text, analyze_document, analyze_expense: {Bytes} or {S3Object:{Bucket,Name,Version?}}.

schema.label: DocumentPages
schema.description: Official AnalyzeID DocumentPages array of {Bytes} or {S3Object}. Identity documents = PII.

schema.label: FeatureTypes
schema.description: AnalyzeDocument FeatureTypes. EXACT: TABLES | FORMS | QUERIES | SIGNATURES | LAYOUT. Required by AnalyzeDocument.

schema.label: QueriesConfig
schema.description: Optional AnalyzeDocument QueriesConfig when FeatureTypes includes QUERIES.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Textract JSON). AnalyzeID / expense fields may contain PII — do not persist longer than the workflow needs. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default Textract action. EXACT: detect_text | analyze_document | analyze_expense | analyze_id. Maps to X-Amz-Target Textract.DetectDocumentText | AnalyzeDocument | AnalyzeExpense | AnalyzeID.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.
